# Hooks Reference

Specialists works inside XTRM. Core/Substrate own durable-work/session enforcement.

## Hook inventory

The package ships no Claude hook scripts. The `SessionStart`, `PreCompact`, and wake hooks come from the `specialists@xtrm` Claude plugin (`plugins/specialists/hooks/hooks.json`). `specialists init` does not install or wire hooks. The former `specialists-session-start.mjs` script was removed (SPECIALISTS-4309).

## Legacy cleanup

Older `specialists init` runs symlinked `.claude/hooks/specialists-*.mjs` into `.xtrm/hooks/specialists/` and added matching `.claude/settings.json` entries. `specialists init` now removes:

- `.claude/hooks/specialists-*.mjs` symlinks that dangle or point into `.xtrm/hooks/specialists/`
- `.claude/settings.json` hook commands that target a missing `.claude/hooks/specialists-*.mjs`

All other hooks, settings keys, and the file's indentation are preserved. Regular files and symlinks to other live targets are never touched.

## Legacy Beads hooks

Beads workflow hooks are legacy/migration compatibility outside this package. Current durable-work authority and lifecycle enforcement belong to Substrate/XTRM. Specialists focuses on activation execution, evidence, and role/runtime policy.
